data.name: Galactiball
data.detailed_description:
Galacticball

Kick. Dive. Bounce. Score. Chaos has never been this competitive.

Welcome to Galacticball, the next great party game... until someone starts taking it seriously.

Kick your friends into the goal. Dive across the arena for a last-second save. Launch an opponent into an incoming boulder. Whether you're playing casually on the couch or climbing the ranked ladder online.

Galacticball blends physics, skill, and absolute chaos into one unforgettable multiplayer experience.

Master a unique movement system built around double jumps, diving, kicking, bouncing, and precise positioning as you outplay your opponents across a growing collection of competitive and party game modes.

Whether you're climbing the ranked ladder, battling friends from the couch, or causing complete chaos online, every match is packed with highlight-worthy moments.

⚽ Soccer

The classic, reimagined.

Compete in 2 teams of up to 6 vs 6 as you pass, intercept, kick, dive, bounce, and launch the ball into your opponents' goal.

Easy to learn. Difficult to master. Built for unforgettable moments.

🏆 Competitive Soccer

A competitively tuned version of Soccer featuring tighter mechanics inspired by the competitive community.

Play a 4-team round of elimination to compete for dominance.

Play Your Way

Whether you're playing solo, with friends, on the couch, or running your own tournament, Galacticball is designed to let you play however you want.

🌐 Online Multiplayer

  • Steam Lobby Integration

  • Public Matchmaking

  • Quick Play

  • Private Matches

  • Competitive Skill-Based Matchmaking

  • Ranked Divisions

  • Global Leaderboards

🎮 Local & Online Together

  • Local Split-Screen Multiplayer (6 players per screen)

  • Take Local Players Online Together (6 player limit per lobby)

  • Assign Individual Controllers to Every Player

  • Multiple Players on One PC (6-player supported)

👥 Incoming Features

  • Discord Assisted Matchmaking

  • Dedicated Private Server Software

  • Host Competitive Leagues or Private Matches

  • Community Tournaments

  • Continuous Balance Updates

  • Multiple game modes.

    • Boulder Dash - Dodge boulders coming down from the mountain and knock your competitors into them.

    • Dodge Bowl - Players take turns sending the ball down the alley at up to 9 of their friends at a time to dodge.

    • Zombie-Ball - One infected player and one infected ball tries to infect up to 11 other players at a time by kicking the zombie-ball into them.

    • Galactigolf - Get your ball into the hole at the end of the run - dodge blackholes, nebulas, and all manner of obstacles along the way.

    • Chaos-Golf - Galactigolf, but instead of turn-based, everyone goes at once for maximum chaos.

    • More coming during early access.

  • These are just the features we're promising. We intend to add much, much more. Join our discord to see what other features we're trying to implement into the game. Anyone interested in testing will be invited into our testing rounds.

Built For The Community; With The Community

Galacticball is being developed alongside its players throughout Early Access.

Your feedback, bug reports, gameplay ideas, and balance discussions will directly influence future development while helping us stay true to the game's original vision.

Whether you're chasing the top of the ranked ladder or simply trying to launch your friends into a giant rolling boulder, you'll be helping shape the future of Galacticball.

Easy to pick up.

Difficult to master.

Impossible to predict.

See you on the field.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: i5-5600 Quad Core or Ryzen 5 1600AF
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia Geforce 960 or AMD Radeon R9 380 for lowest settings
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Full Controller Support for any device your Windows Installation can recognize.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core Ultra 9 or AMD Ryzen 9 for best performance and local splitscreen and multiscreen
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia RTX 5070 or AMD RX 9070 XT for ultra settings.
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Full Controller Support for any device your Windows Installation can recognize.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Latest Kernel supported - Ubuntu, Arch, and SteamOS supported.
  • Processor: i5-5600 Quad Core or Ryzen 5 1600AF
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia Geforce 960 or AMD Radeon R9 380 for lowest settings
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Full Controller Support for any HID installed correctly to your operating system.
